The map $(\delta,\theta)\mapsto w_0+\sqrt{\delta/\mu_1}\cos\theta\,e_1+\sqrt{\delta/\mu_2}\sin\theta\,e_2$ is a diffeomorphism of $(0,\infty)\times(0,2\pi)$ onto the plane with the ray $w_0+\{r e_1:r\ge0\}$ removed, with $q=v+\delta$ and absolute Jacobian $1/(2\sqrt{\det B})$.
